## E6 — risk-controlled release of hint-based decisions (LTT, tracker-withheld arm)

Risk = P(released not_affected/fixed ∧ gold affected) over all cases; 200 CVE-level re-splits (40% calibration / 60% evaluation) of the pooled pool of splits ['calib', 'dev'] (n = 38 DC withheld-arm episodes).
